[SWS_PHM_00222]
{DRAFT}
Switch Global Supervision Status from
kOK
to
kDE-
ACTIVATED
⌈
If the
Global Supervision Status
is
kOK
or
kFAILED
or
kEX-
PIRED
AND the
Elementary Supervision Status
of all Alive, Deadline and Logi-
cal Supervisions is
kDEACTIVATED
, then the
Platform Health Management
shall
set the
Global Supervision Status
to
kDEACTIVATED
and stop measuring Ex-
pired Supervision Time.
⌋
(RS_PHM_00111)
See transitions (6), (14) and (15) in figure
7.6.
These transitions can occur when State Management has caused change in the state
of the
Function Group
corresponding to the Global Supervision such that the Pro-
cesses corresponding to the
Supervised Entity
instances whose Supervisions
(
Alive Supervisions
,
Deadline Supervisions
and/or
Logical Supervi-
sions
) are aggregated in the Global Supervision, are terminated. Typically, this can
occur due to change in
Function Group
state to Off state.
